before: I study how precursor chemistry and confined vapour transport shape low-dimensional materials. My work connects close-space growth experiments with independent SEM/EDS characterisation, Raman and photoluminescence spectroscopy, and Python analysis.
after: I study how precursor chemistry and confined vapour transport shape low-dimensional materials. My work combines controlled growth experiments, transport modelling, microscopy and spectroscopy with reproducible Python analysis to connect processing conditions with material structure and optical response.

before: I am a {{profile.role_short}} in the {{profile.group}} at {{profile.institution_short}}, working on tungsten oxides and transition-metal dichalcogenides. My doctoral research examines how source chemistry, source–substrate geometry and processing conditions influence material formation.

I combine controlled growth experiments with independent ex-situ SEM imaging, SEM-EDS elemental analysis and quantitative Raman/PL measurements. I also analyse collaborator-acquired operando SEM images and develop RamanPL_2D to turn spectroscopy datasets into fitted parameters, spatial maps and structured outputs.

Alongside research, I deliver practical SEM training to new PhD researchers, support student imaging projects and have demonstrated SEM to two NanoDTC cohorts. Earlier work at Oxford connected photonic-device measurements with design and simulation; my broader experience includes technology assessment and deep-tech commercialisation.
after: I am a {{profile.role_short}} in the {{profile.group}} at {{profile.institution_short}}, working on tungsten oxides and transition-metal dichalcogenides. My doctoral research examines how source chemistry, source–substrate geometry and processing conditions influence material formation.

I independently acquire SEM/EDS and Raman/PL data. I have also collected and analysed Bruker XRD data for tungsten oxides and suboxides using reference-pattern matching, phase identification and lattice-parameter analysis.

I combine these measurements with local transport modelling and analysis of collaborator-acquired operando SEM images. I develop RamanPL_2D to turn spectroscopy datasets into fitted parameters, spatial maps and structured outputs. Earlier work at Oxford connected photonic-device measurements with design and simulation.

before: Close-space sublimation and oxide-to-sulphide conversion: relating precursor chemistry and confined transport to the morphology of low-dimensional materials.
after: Close-space CVD experiments and local transport modelling connect precursor chemistry and source–substrate geometry with low-dimensional oxide and sulphide formation.

before: Independent SEM imaging and SEM-EDS elemental analysis, combined with Raman/PL mapping and collaborative structural and chemical evidence, connect processing conditions with morphology, composition and optical response.
after: Independent SEM/EDS, Raman/PL and Bruker XRD measurements relate morphology, elemental composition, crystal structure and optical response to processing conditions.

before: How can source treatment and source–substrate geometry guide planar WS₂ growth?

I investigated salt-assisted close-space growth through paired source–substrate analysis and Raman/PL measurements. I independently acquired SEM-EDS spectra and elemental maps on NaCl-treated SiO₂/Si controls to verify salt deposition before growth.
This work forms part of my {{qualification:EDU-CAM:thesis}}; a first-author manuscript is {{status:P1:lower}}.
after: How can source treatment and source–substrate geometry guide planar WS₂ growth?
I designed a close-space growth configuration and combined local COMSOL flow modelling with controlled CVD comparisons to assess precursor delivery and source/substrate cross-contamination.

Paired source–substrate characterisation and Raman/PL measurements connect growth conditions with material formation. I independently acquired SEM-EDS spectra and maps on NaCl-treated SiO₂/Si controls to verify salt deposition before growth.
This work forms part of my {{qualification:EDU-CAM:thesis}}; a first-author manuscript is {{status:P1:lower}}.

after.title: Training and laboratory contributions
text: I wrote a group SOP for Raman characterisation and analysis and trained researchers in SEM and Raman workflows. I also support student imaging projects and have demonstrated SEM imaging of two-dimensional MoS₂ to two NanoDTC cohorts.
My laboratory contributions include CVD reactor maintenance, pressure and precursor-delivery checks using mass-flow controllers and needle valves, and preparing departmental safety assessments.
